items.answer: Cumulative frequencies: 10, 13, 18, 30, 41. Days with rainfall less than 50 mm = 41.
items.markingKey: 3 marks: 2 for the cumulative frequency column, 1 for reading the required value.

items.stem:
Study the extract below and answer the questions.
"Data are tabulated and classified to make them easy to understand and compare. In the inclusive method both the lower and the upper limits are part of the class interval. A frequency polygon is drawn by joining the mid-points of the tops of the bars of a histogram. Data can be presented as absolute data, as ratios or percentages, or as index numbers."
(i) Explain the term 'frequency polygon', which is related to the theme of the extract. (1)
(ii) Using the extract and your own knowledge, explain the following: Tally marks are used in grouping data. (1)
(iii) A student concludes: "An ogive is a type of bar diagram." Use your knowledge of the chapter to evaluate this conclusion. (1)
items.answer: (i) A graph drawn by joining the mid-points of the tops of the bars of a histogram. (ii) They make it quick and easy to count the frequency of values falling in each class. (iii) The conclusion is wrong: An ogive is a cumulative frequency curve.
items.markingKey: 1+1+1 marks: (i) A graph drawn by joining the mid-points of the tops of the bars of a histogram. (ii) They make it quick and easy to count the frequency of values falling in each class. (iii) The conclusion is wrong: An ogive is a cumulative frequency curve.
